_about: John's own corrections to the Station exits table, applied last by build_exits_table.py, so they win over the station maps and the map data. Per station: 'names' renames exits (old name: the words used after 'to', as in 'to the town centre and Station Hill'); 'here' says how to put 'is right there' for a renamed exit; 'bridge' is the word for the station's footbridge. Each entry says who and when. 'by' sets the platforms an exit is by; 'no_routes' keeps no routes (only what John knows); 'no_exit' names an exit John says isn't there (the build stops if it appears). 'add_exits' adds exits the sources missed; 'level_crossing' says the exits are either side of a public level crossing. 'say' gives John's own words for a platform, after 'Your train is due into platform N.'; 'mention_other' also names the other exit over the bridge or through the subway, from a platform with an exit on the level.
